access_boundary: This record represents the Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 release, the July 2025 thinking-only update of Qwen3-30B-A3B, at Hugging Face commit 144afc2f379b542fdd4e85a1fcd5e1f79112d95d (last modified 2025-08-17), together with the hosted qwen3-30b-a3b-thinking-2507 API model. The original hybrid Qwen3-30B-A3B, the Instruct-2507 variant, FP8 and other quantized repackagings, and later Qwen generations remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Ungated Safetensors shards with a standard Apache-2.0 license file are published directly by the developer
First-party Model Studio serving under the exact qwen3-30b-a3b-thinking-2507 model ID
tradeoffs: Thinking is always on and the chat template inserts the opening think tag, so output parsing differs from the hybrid release
Version identity rests on repository commits with no stated retirement posture
